name: Silence
doc: Silence (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks), each a prim-model layout at an effect point of the action's target, followed every tick; the target is marked (flags word bit 0x2000) while it plays and takes the result at tick 50.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layout's blended vertex frames (after the three target nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn; each target task's clock: its sound, its result, its end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Layout
parts.doc: The layout played on the action's target, at one of its effect points every tick

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its drawing depth: (Base - the target's size word) >> Shift

groups.label: Nearer object
groups.doc: This object of the layout is drawn By nearer (-1: none)

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the anchor when the target tick == this

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The target task ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Bone
params.doc: The target's effect point the layout is at (0xF0 and up: the engine's named points)

tasks.doc: One per action: the layout at the action's target's effect point, taken every tick, each object's offset added to it through the camera (record flags 0x200: the anchor through the camera + the offset as is, not turned; 0x100: scaled by a diagonal matrix); object 4 drawn nearer; the sound at its first tick; the result; then the target's mark cleared.
